# All Sorted

> All Sorted is an AI-powered business operating system with prebuilt agents for CRM, billing, scheduling, email, content, and business admin. It is positioned as a ready-to-run system for service-based businesses that want operations handled without complex setup.

Last updated: 2026-06-19

## Primary Page

- [Home](https://getallsorted.ai): Main product page covering the offer, core agents, key workflows, and call to action.
- [Features](https://getallsorted.ai/features): Detailed feature page covering the included task board, security, content, CRM, reporting, and install architecture.
- [Agents](https://getallsorted.ai/agents): The full catalog. Every one of the 61 agents and 66 modules that ship, grouped into 11 areas of a service business, with what each one does, what it can do, what it needs from the customer, and whether it requires explicit confirmation before acting. Machine-readable at https://getallsorted.ai/data/agents.json.

## Summary

- Product: AI business operating system
- Audience: service-based small business owners and operators
- Promise: core business workflows handled by prebuilt AI agents
- Key surfaces: CRM, billing, scheduling, email, content, security, and business operations
